# Oracle pins (对照 libraries)

CI only recognizes the locked versions below. Upgrading an oracle is its
own PR: bump the pin, run the binding's full T1–T6, all green to merge.

| binding | oracle library | pinned | update command |
|---|---|---|---|
| node | `protobufjs` | 8.8.1 | `make oracle-update LANG=node` (see below) |
| python | `protobuf` (`google.protobuf`) | 7.36.2 | `make oracle-update LANG=python` |
| ruby | `google-protobuf` gem | 4.36.2 | `gem update google-protobuf`, regenerate `tests/gen_oracle`, run T1–T6 |
| go | `google.golang.org/protobuf` | v1.36.12 | `go get google.golang.org/protobuf@latest`, regenerate `tests/gen_oracle`, run T1–T6 |
| rust | `prost` / `prost-build` | 0.14.4 (Cargo.lock) | `cargo update -p prost`, regenerate `tests/gen_oracle`, run T1–T6 |
| csharp | `Google.Protobuf` (NuGet) | 3.36.2 | update `PackageReference`, regenerate `oracle/gen_oracle`, run T1–T6 |
| php | official PHP runtime (`php/src`) + `protoc --php_out` oracle | v36.2 | regenerate `tests/gen_oracle` with repo protoc, run T1–T6 |
| dart | `protobuf` pub package (protoc-gen-dart oracle) | 6.1.0 (pubspec.lock), protoc-gen-dart from protoc_plugin 25.1.0 | `dart pub upgrade`, regenerate `tests/gen_oracle`, run T1–T6 |
| objc | protobuf ObjC runtime + `protoc --objc_out` (cached checkout) | v36.2 (`GOOGLE_PROTOBUF_OBJC_VERSION` 40311) | re-run `bindings/objc/build.sh` typed; pin asserted at compile time in `tests/typed_test.m` |
| java | `protobuf-java` | 4.36.2 (locked in `bindings/java/build.sh` + `RuntimeVersion` assert) | re-fetch jar, re-`protoc` oracle, run T1–T6 |
| kotlin | `protobuf-java` (same jar, thin DSL over Java classes) | 4.36.2 (locked in `bindings/kotlin/build.sh`) | same as java |
| c | libprotobuf (`protoc --cpp_out`), 36.2.0 | compile-time `GOOGLE_PROTOBUF_VERSION` check in `bindings/cpp/tests/compat_oracle.cc` | re-run `make compat-oracle` |
| cpp | same as C (shared struct codec), 36.2.0 | same TU | same as C |

## node

The oracle lives in `bindings/node/benchmarks/node_modules/protobufjs`.
It is a plain npm install, pinned by exact version in that directory's
`package.json`; the compat test asserts
`require('protobufjs/package.json').version` equals the pin, so drift
fails loudly instead of silently.

Update: `cd bindings/node/benchmarks && npm install protobufjs@latest`
then set the pin in the compat test and run T1–T6.

## python

The oracle is the official runtime (`google.protobuf`) plus `_pb2`
modules generated by the repo's `protoc` into
`bindings/python/tests/gen_oracle/` (committed, stamped by that `protoc`;
regenerate with `make -C bindings/typed gen-python` when `protoc` moves).

`protoc` and the runtime move as a pair (e.g. `protoc` 36.2 stamps
gencode 7.36.2, which refuses to load under an older runtime), so the pin
tracks the newest `pip install protobuf` that loads the repo's `protoc`
output.

Update: `python3 -m pip install --upgrade "protobuf==<new>"`,
regenerate the `_pb2` oracle, run T1–T6.

## Adding a language

Add one row here (library + exact version + where it is locked, in the
language's native lockfile), one T4 adapter in that binding's compat
test, and nothing else. No second wire implementation, ever.
